passive.name: The Plum Fragrance In My Bones
passive.text:
Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **60/70/80/90/100%**. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases all allies' DMG by **24/28/32/36/40%**, lasting for **3** turn(s). If the wearer's Break Effect exceeds or equals **150%**, 1 Skill Point will be recovered.
At the start of each wave, all allies regenerate **10/12.5/15/17.5/20** Energy immediately. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Flustered
passive.text: After entering combat, increases all allies' Break DMG dealt by **16/18/20/22/24%**. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Old Photo
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **28/35/42/49/56%**. When the wearer attacks, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

passive.name: Fleet Triumph
passive.text: After the wearer uses attacks or gets hit, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

substatLine: Break Effect (Until 180%) > SPD (Until Breakpoint) > HP% = DEF% > Effect RES
tracePriority: Candle Lights on Still Waters (A6) > Inert Respiration (A2) > Days Wane, Thoughts Wax (A4)

entries.name: Threading Fragrance
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Ruan Mei's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: String Sings Slow Swirls
entries.text: After using her Skill, Ruan Mei gains Overtone, lasting for **3** turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Ruan Mei's every turn. When Ruan Mei has Overtone, all allies' DMG increases by **32%** and Weakness Break Efficiency increases by **50%**.

entries.name: Petals to Stream, Repose in Dream
entries.text:
Ruan Mei deploys a Zone that lasts for **2** turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of her turn.
While inside the Zone, all allies' All-Type RES PEN increases by **25%** and their attacks apply Thanatoplum Rebloom to the enemies hit.
When these enemies attempt to recover from Weakness Break, Thanatoplum Rebloom is triggered, extending the duration of their Weakness Break, delaying their action by an amount equal to **20%** of Ruan Mei's Break Effect plus **10%**, and dealing Break DMG equal to **50%** of Ruan Mei's Ice Break DMG.
Enemy targets cannot have Thanatoplum Rebloom re-applied to them until they recover from Weakness Break.

entries.name: Somatotypical Helix
entries.text: Increases SPD by **10%** for all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit). When allies Break an enemy target's Weakness, Ruan Mei deals to this enemy target Break DMG equal to **120%** of her Ice Break DMG.

entries.name: Silken Serenade
entries.text:
After using the Technique, gains Silken Serenade. At the start of the next battle, automatically triggers the Skill for **1** time(s) without consuming Skill Points.
In Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, when Ruan Mei has Silken Serenade, the team actively attacking enemies will always be regarded as attacking their Weakness to enter combat, and this attack can reduce all enemies' Toughness regardless of Weakness types. When breaking Weakness, triggers Weakness Break Effect corresponding to the attacker's Type. For every Blessing in possession (up to a max of **20** Blessings will be taken into account), additionally increases the Toughness Reduction of this attack by **100%**. After breaking an enemy target's Weakness, additionally deals to the enemy target Break DMG equal to **100%** of Ruan Mei's Ice Break DMG.

entries.name: Inert Respiration
entries.text: Increases Break Effect by **20%** for all allies.

entries.name: Days Wane, Thoughts Wax
entries.text: Ruan Mei regenerates **5** Energy at the start of her turn.

entries.name: Candle Lights on Still Waters
entries.text: In battle, for every **10%** of Ruan Mei's Break Effect that exceeds **120%**, her Skill additionally increases allies' DMG by **6%**, up to a maximum of **36%**.

entries.name: Neuronic Embroidery
entries.text: While the Ultimate's Zone is deployed, the DMG dealt by all allies ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

entries.name: Reedside Promenade
entries.text: While Ruan Mei is on the field, all allies increase their ATK by 40% when dealing DMG to enemies that are Weakness Broken.

entries.name: Viridescent Pirouette
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Chatoyant Éclat
entries.text: When an enemy target's Weakness is Broken, Ruan Mei's Break Effect increases by 100% for 3 turn(s).

entries.name: Languid Barrette
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Sash Cascade
entries.text: Extends the duration of the Ultimate's Zone by 1 turn(s). The Talent's Break DMG multiplier additionally increases by 200%.
